title: Scheduling Bulletin on the Length of Cartridge and Reservoir Refills, Insulin Pump Program
content:
On an Insulin Pump Program the 30-day blocks of a cartridge or reservoir refill follow the program's records in three cases:

1. Where the pump on the program was delivered fewer than 90 days (the new-pump start days) before the ship date, the standard blocks are replaced with one 30-day block.
2. Where the pump was delivered at least 90 days before the ship date and the newest authorization grant for the cartridge item covers fewer days than the standard refill period, counting from the ship date through the grant's valid-through date with both days included, the standard blocks are replaced with the whole 30-day blocks within those days, any part block dropped.
3. Otherwise the standard blocks stand.

The pump's age is counted in calendar days from the pump delivery date written on the program to the ship date. The newest authorization grant for the cartridge item is the program's A4225 or A4232 grant, as the pump model uses, with the latest valid-from date. The standard refill period is the tier's supply days per shipment divided by 30.

| Hypothetical case (tier shipping 90 days) | Blocks |
|---|---|
| Pump delivered 30 days before the ship date | replaced with 1 |
| Pump delivered 90 days before; grant covers 150 days from the ship date | standard blocks stand |
| Pump delivered 400 days before; grant covers 75 days from the ship date, both days included | replaced with 2 (the 15-day remainder is dropped) |
| Pump delivered 400 days before; grant covers 30 days | replaced with 1 |
